entry_route.value: Applicants with bachelor's degrees may apply directly to doctoral programs.
entry_route.quote: While applicants with bachelor's degrees may apply directly to certain doctoral programs, the Graduate School also reserves the right to offer applicants admission at the master's degree level in its place.

gre_general.value: The GRE (general or topical) is NOT REQUIRED for admission by any of the programs in the Department of Biological Sciences.
